verdict.rationale: Unity documents automation building blocks: Build Automation's continuous-integration features for multiplatform builds, headless batchmode/command-line runs to "automate workflows," and a standalone CLI aimed at CI pipelines and build agents. None of the evidence mentions scheduling or recurring triggers, so recurring execution would have to come from an external scheduler or CI system driving these tools. Missing for 10: a native scheduled/recurring job or build trigger (e.g. cron-style schedules in Build Automation), documentation of recurring workflow configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
